coverage: All blob paths in owned scope in origin, initial source or latest observed source; documented product/interface assignment applied. Other snapshots are comparisons, never source authority. Docs indexed separately.
reason_for_held_paths: H-INTERFACE: ACK/revocation/physical browser slice consumed. C05 work-selection/history and contribution import-preview route require domain/host closure; foreign import/document snapshots are not canonical.

decision_legend.CONSUMED_EXACT_BLOB: Published owner blob copied byte-for-byte; exact provenance in R04-reconciliation.json.
decision_legend.DEDUP_IDENTICAL_TO_CONSUMED: Identical resulting blob already consumed from another pinned input; no second application.
decision_legend.ALREADY_PRESENT_IDENTICAL: Same blob in W0 and C; no new intake or behavior claim.
decision_legend.KEEP_COMPOSITION_PATH: Source absence does not authorize deleting existing composition.
decision_legend.KEEP_NEWER_COMPOSITION: Source is still at merge-base blob; retain composition changes.
decision_legend.HOLD_OWNER_RECONCILIATION: H-INTERFACE: ACK/revocation/physical browser slice consumed. C05 work-selection/history and contribution import-preview route require domain/host closure; foreign import/document snapshots are not canonical.
decision_legend.HOLD_NEW_EXPLICIT_INPUT: Path only appeared after pin; latest blob recorded, not consumed.

evidence_limitation: Byte equality proves identity, not behavioral acceptance. Scoped CI only covers its explicit selection. No native/final gate credit.
